How It Works

Investment Process

Four steps to complete your South Africa property investment, fully compliant and transparent

1

TPFA Trust Receipt

Investment funds are deposited into a lawyer's TPFA (Third Party Funds Account) trust account, disbursed per contractual milestones, with funds fully protected by law.

2

Signing & Compliance

Sign the property purchase agreement with the developer, with local lawyers witnessing throughout to ensure FICA compliance. TPFA disburses funds to the developer in stages per contract.

3

Handover & Account Transfer

Upon completion, remaining funds are transferred from TPFA to your Standard Bank Wealth private banking account, immediately earning interest.

4

Dual-Engine Income

Guaranteed rental income is deposited monthly into your private banking account, while savings interest accrues daily and compounds monthly — two engines generating continuous cash flow.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Investment funds are deposited into a lawyer's TPFA (Third Party Funds Account) trust account, never passing through the advisory firm. The lawyer disburses funds to the developer per contractual milestones. Upon handover, remaining funds are transferred to the investor's personal Standard Bank Wealth private banking account. The entire process complies with FICA anti-money laundering regulations.

The guaranteed rental yield is calculated at 8-10% annual return on the property value, with monthly rent deposited directly into the investor's South African bank account. DingYao provides rental management services through Crestline Advisory, covering tenant screening, lease management, and rent collection. This package uses a conservative 8% for projections.

The 6.5% annual interest rate is a Standard Bank Money Market promotional rate, with daily accrual, monthly payout, and compounding interest. South African Rand exchange rate fluctuations may affect actual returns when converted to other currencies, but the account is fully controlled by the investor, funds are accessible at any time with no lock-in period.

Yes. DingYao exclusively provides a digital asset management platform (Client Portal) featuring construction progress live streaming, rental income dashboards, and a cloud document vault, allowing you to oversee your overseas assets from Taiwan as if you were on-site.

South Africa's Financial Independence Visa only requires proof of global net assets of ZAR 16 million, with no immigration monitoring requirement, making it an excellent choice for high-net-worth Taiwanese individuals seeking PR in an English-speaking country. Legal fees for this investment package already include PR application assistance.
